description:
Removes an issue type from an issue type scheme.

This operation cannot remove:

 *  any issue type used by issues.
 *  any issue types from the default issue type scheme.
 *  the last standard issue type from an issue type scheme.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the issue type scheme.
parameters.name: issueTypeSchemeId

parameters.description: The ID of the issue type.
parameters.name: issueTypeId

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["Can't remove the last standard issue type from the issue type scheme."],"errors":{}}

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["Only Jira administrators can access issue type schemes."],"errors":{}}

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["The issue type was not found in the issue type scheme."],"errors":{}}

404.description: Returned if the issue type scheme is missing or the issue type is not found in the issue type scheme.

summary: Remove issue type from issue type scheme
